Frequently Asked Questions

How does featured placement work?

Your listing is pinned to the top position on your city's page, above all other retreats. It retains its "Featured" badge so visitors know it's a promoted listing. Your star rating and review count are always shown unmodified.

Can more than one retreat be featured per city?

No. We limit featured placement to one retreat per city page. This ensures your listing stands alone at the top without competing featured placements.

Does featured placement affect my rating?

Never. Your displayed star rating and review count come directly from public business data and are never altered by paid placement. Featured listings are clearly labeled.

How do I claim my listing?

Visit your retreat's profile page and click "Claim This Listing." You'll need to verify your association with the business. Once verified, you can manage contact details and apply for featured placement.

What if my city page has an open featured slot?

If no retreat is currently featured in your city, the slot is open and available immediately on a first-come basis. Contact us to check availability.
